descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S21 「登录界面、协议界面和 Settings 上的 axe 和设计检查，桌面和手机 profile」 axe and a design look on the sign-in screen, the agreements screen and Settings, on desktop and phone profiles

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 The sign-in screen says 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI') and 'Sign in or create an account with a code sent to your email'.（TFA-94513 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest …（UAT OAT-01 step 7；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94700 AC 7；TFA-94700 AC 8；TFA-94700 AC 9；TFA-94700 AC 11；UAT 3.3）
  • T12 The Settings and agreements screens match the current app UI (no redesign).（TFA-94700 AC 6）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, pixel7 and iphone15 (WebKit)

When Run axe on / signed out, on the agreements screen for a fresh account that has not accepted, and on /settings

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Both checkboxes have accessible names equal to their visible text. Continue and Decline are named buttons. The code field has a label. Nothing is cut off or overlapped at phone width. The Settings and agreements screens look like the rest of the current app (no redesign).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-checks.ts axe count = 0, plus the existing overflow / truncated / tap checks = 0 per screen and profile. T12 (TFA-94700 AC 6): a person compares the Settings and agreements screenshots with the current app screens; vision-review findings need a human.

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94513 in progress；TFA-94700 ready for qa

登录验证码那一步的「Resend code」「Use a different email」只有 16 px 高，在 iPhone 模拟下点按尺寸不达标；登录页底部文字和 Send code 按钮对比度不达 AA；Settings 的关闭（X）按钮没有名字。

On the sign-in code step 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' are 16 px-tall text buttons that fail the tap-size rule in iPhone emulation, the sign-in footer and the Send-code button fail AA contrast, and Settings has an unnamed close (X) button.

依据：allure 491bc916-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-01_S21: 55 checks pass, 13 fail. The 297×16 buttons fail WCAG 2.5.8 in iPhone 15 WebKit emulation but pass in Chromium (Pixel 7), about 1 px apart, so confirm on a real iPhone. Field labels, checkbox names and Continue/Decline names pass. T12 (looks like the current app) is left to a person.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：EXPLORATORY · 探索测试 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S21

axe and a design look on the sign-in screen, the agreements screen and Settings, on desktop and phone profiles

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：account.spec.ts: signed-out context for the sign-in screen and its code step (send-code endpoint stubbed, no code typed), a fresh account without consent for the agreements screen, /settings; axe = 0, checkbox names == visible text, Continue/Decline named, code field label, overflow/truncated/covered/tap on phones; vision-review for the design look. [2026-10-14 review] Re-run with the stricter 'covered' rule (a fixed layer over a fixed layer is high). — T12 (looks like the rest of the current app, no redesign) is a person's comparison; vision-review only lists suspicions.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 55 judged check(s) passed, 13 failed. Sign-in (and its code step, delivery stubbed), agreements for an account without consent, Settings. Field labels, checkbox names (== visible text), Continue/Decline names all pass. T12 (looks like the current app) is for a person: screenshots plus vision/design findings.

产品问题：On the sign-in code step, 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' are 16 px-tall stacked text buttons, on the edge of the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception: they fail it in the iPhone 15 WebKit emulation (297×16) and pass it in Chromium (Pixel 7, 316×16), about a pixel of line height apart — confirm on a real iPhone before filing it as iPhone-specific. Contrast: the 'Round Companion — Physician Access Only' footer and the Send-code button (white on teal) fail AA on sign-in; Settings has an unnamed close (X) button. Breaks the oracle 'axe count = 0 … tap = 0 per screen and profile'.

证据：附了 9 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/OAT-01_S21 — 目录（27 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the agreements screen also needs a fresh account that has not accepted, which dev cannot make.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
